newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Sao Paulo industrial activity up 19.9 pct in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Sao Paulo industrial activity up 19.9 pct in Sept.

text.p: Sao Paulo state's industrial activity rose 19.9 percent in September, compared with the same month last year, the Sao Paulo state Industries Federation (Fiesp) said in a statement.
Sao Paulo's industrial activity also rose 0.3 percent against the previous month.
Industrial sales jumped 14.8 percent in September against the same month last year, but dropped 0.2 percent when compared with August, it added.
